rows.label: Railjack
rows.note: Rising Tide; for the Saturn Proxima confrontation

rows.label: Rank 5 Railjack Intrinsics
rows.note: any one class; Saturn Proxima access

conditions: You can have only one active adversary. Clear or convert any existing Lich, Sister, or Coda before starting.
The final showdown is locked behind Saturn Proxima; check the Railjack requirements before investing in a Lich.

groups.place: KUVA SIPHON OR KUVA FLOOD, ANY
groups.activity: earn and crack Requiem Eterna Relics

rows.label: charged Requiem mods
rows.alt: trade duplicates or buy cheap mods from players

rows.label: Oull
rows.note: wildcard Requiem; optional but very strong

conditions: Requiem Eterna Relics contain the eight Requiem mods at equal odds and cannot be refined. Kuva Flood drops one every time, Kuva Siphon 50%, and Thralls 5%.
Crack them in Requiem Void Fissures on the Kuva Fortress.
Each successful Lich vanquish consumes one charge from every equipped Requiem mod. Defiled mods have no charges left.
Palladino also sells retired Requiem I-IV relics for 10 Riven Slivers each, capped at 10 per week.
bonuses: Oull substitutes for any Requiem and has three charges. Two Oulls cannot be equipped in the same sequence.

disclosures.title: do this before spawning the Lich
disclosures.body: A new Lich is not removable until its three-Requiem sequence is solved. Stock one or two of each Requiem first so a reveal never stalls you while you crack relics mid-hunt.

groups.activity: Capture; spawn and inspect Kuva Larvlings
groups.meta: one full pool cycle at worst

rows.label: Kuva Hind Larvling
rows.note: weapon preview must say Kuva Hind
rows.alt: buy a converted Kuva Hind Lich from another player

rows.label: progenitor of choice
rows.note: sets the bonus element; irrelevant for Mastery
rows.alt: Elemental Vice can change the element later at rank 40

conditions: After the yellow flicker, kill 15 enemies within about 30 seconds to spawn the Larvling. The downed Larvling previews its weapon before you Mercy it.
If the preview is not Hind, leave it un-mercied and complete the mission. That weapon leaves the rotation until all other Kuva weapons have appeared; aborting does not advance the rotation.
You cannot Mercy a Larvling while any adversary -- Lich, Sister, or Coda -- is already active.

Bring a wide nuke frame (Saryn, Mag, Frost, Volt, Mirage, Rhino, Uriel) so you hit the kill count without depending on line of sight, and spawn solo: only the last player to damage the Larvling can Mercy it, and a squadmate's frame can end up as the progenitor.
bonuses: Every player receives 100 Kuva when a Larvling goes down, whether it is Mercied or refused.

disclosures.title: the only reliable weapon reroll
disclosures.body: Do not abort unwanted Larvlings. Finishing the mission without using Mercy is what removes that shown weapon from the candidate pool and eventually guarantees the Hind; an abort leaves it eligible.

groups.activity: kill Thralls, reveal mods, and test the sequence

rows.label: revealed Requiems
rows.note: Murmurs reveal mods, not their order

conditions: Thralls on your Lich's influence nodes build both Murmur progress and rage; joining another Lich's node grants Murmur but does not raise your own rage.
Murmur reveals arrive around 36, 60, and 84 progress, but the final three-mod order must be learned by Parazon attempts.

A failed Parazon attempt ranks up the Lich and moves it onward (Earth, Mars, Ceres, Sedna, Kuva Fortress), but gives the squad 10 Murmurs. Do not stab before a mod is revealed; afterward, stab to learn the order.
Clearing every influenced node on a planet ranks the Lich up anyway, even with no failed stab.
While the Lich lives, it taxes about 0.7% of rewards per occupied node; you get it all back on Vanquish.
On Interception, Mercy every Thrall before 100%, or they despawn with the other enemies.
Never stab with no Requiems slotted, and never Mercy a Larvling without checking its weapon; both are how players end up stuck with an unwanted Lich.
bonuses: Public squads accelerate Murmurs because failed attempts by any player benefit everyone.
When your Lich appears, let it enthrall nearby Grineer (up to 10, one batch every 20 seconds) before dealing with it. Down it three times without stabbing and it leaves without ranking up.
Doing one mission per planet and popping a saved Requiem Ultimatum at the end gets experienced players under an hour.

disclosures.title: use Oull to cap the guessing
disclosures.body: Once one mod is known, use Oull to test positions efficiently. Oull -> mod 1 -> random, then Oull -> mod 2 -> mod 1, then mod 1 -> Oull -> mod 2, then mod 2 -> Oull -> mod 1 guarantees the kill by Lich level 4 in the worst case.

disclosures.title: make the spawn loop fit the goal
disclosures.body: Thralls spawn on a timer, up to 10 per mission, so do not speedrun. Start on long missions (Survival, Excavation, Interception, Mobile Defense) for Murmurs; later, when you only need rage, run Capture, Sabotage, or Exterminate. A Requiem Ultimatum from Palladino (10 Riven Slivers, one per week) forces your Lich to spawn on one of its nodes; use it solo, since in a squad it can summon a teammate's Lich instead.

conditions: Choose Vanquish, never Convert. Conversion gives a tradeable Lich contract instead of the weapon. You have 20 seconds; no choice defaults to Vanquish.
The weapon ignores its normal Mastery Rank restriction when claimed from a Lich, but still needs its own weapon slot.
A vanquish has a 25% chance to award Oull and a separate 25% chance to award a Requiem Ultimatum.
bonuses: The Hind arrives built; no crafting materials or Foundry timer are needed.
Mastery runs to rank 40 through 5 Forma, 4,000 in total.

disclosures.title: the Railjack does not need to be great
disclosures.body: There is no squad bonus for a Kuva confrontation and solo is faster. Mk III parts from the dojo dry dock plus a hull or shield mod are enough; a fragile ship can park behind cover while you Archwing the crewships. Liches have Damage Attenuation, so fast-firing, low-damage-per-shot weapons beat big single hits.

rows.label: 60% bonus
rows.alt: stop at the first usable roll

conditions: Valence Fusion sets the result to min(1.1 x the higher bonus, 60%), rounded down to one decimal. Any result of at least 58% becomes 60%.
Do not fuse mediocre copies early. Keep several and fuse every donor into the highest roll; a 53% displayed bonus guarantees 60% on the next fusion.
Start the fusion from the Hind you want to keep. Catalysts, Forma, Exilus adapters, Focus lenses, and Elemental Vice on the donor are destroyed.
Elemental Vice can change the bonus element only after rank 40 (five Forma); it does not change the percentage.
bonuses: Only one copy needs the desired progenitor element because Valence Fusion lets you select the surviving element.

disclosures.title: a 60% chase is several full Liches
disclosures.body: The bonus rolls uniformly from 25% to 60%, so reaching 60% commonly means two to four additional complete Lich cycles. Treat it as an optional long-term goal rather than part of getting a usable Hind.

disclosures.title: a mid-tier rifle
disclosures.body: Most lists put the Kuva Hind at B-C tier and Incarnons outperform it, so people mostly farm it for Mastery or as a comfortable burst rifle.
